questions.q: I become ____ after watching too much television.
questions.zh: 電視看太多後使我感到厭煩。
questions.explain:
bored（感到厭煩的）⇒ 修飾「人」
boring（令人厭煩的）⇒ 修飾「物」

questions.q: I felt ____ by his interest in my new invention.
questions.zh: 他對我的新發明的興致使我深受鼓舞。
questions.explain: 用過去分詞形容人的情緒，表示「某人感到～」。

questions.q: He sat there ____ a novel.
questions.zh: 他坐在那裡看小說。
questions.explain: sit 之後用現在分詞作主詞補語。

questions.q: Don't wake up the ____ child.
questions.zh: 不要吵醒睡眠中的小孩。
questions.explain: the sleeping child = the child asleep

questions.q: A proverb goes: "A ____ stone gathers no moss."
questions.zh: 有句諺語云：「滾石不生苔。」
questions.explain: a rolling stone（滾動的石頭）

questions.q: The heavy rain kept us ____ for two hours.
questions.zh: 這場雨使我們等了兩小時。
questions.explain:
① waiting 是現在分詞，作受詞補語。
② keep（人）waiting（使人等候）

questions.q: I found a dog ____ over by a car on the road.
questions.zh: 我發現一條狗在路上被車輾過。
questions.explain:
① find + 受詞 + p.p. ⇒ 表示被動。
② run-ran-run

questions.q: We found the baby ____ on the floor.（複選）
questions.zh: 我們發現寶寶在地板上睡著了。
questions.explain:
① find + 人 + 形容詞（發現某人的情形或狀態）
② slept 與 sleeping 均可當形容詞用，但睡著是主動，因此用現在分詞。
（本題 (C) asleep 與 (D) sleeping 均正確）

questions.q: Jack saw a woman ____ near the dog, so he walked up to her.
questions.zh: 傑克看到一位婦女站在狗的不遠處，所以他就向她那兒走去。
questions.explain: see + 人 + V-ing（看見人正在…）

questions.q: They got their car ____ at the garage.
questions.zh: 他們在車庫清洗了他們的車子。
questions.explain: get + O. + p.p. 表示「被動」

questions.q: ____ with his report, I told him to write it all over again.
questions.zh: 因為我對他的報告不滿意，所以我叫他重新再寫一次。
questions.explain:
① 原句 = As I was not satisfied...,
② Not being satisfied = Dissatisfied

questions.q: ____ our shoes in our hands, we crossed the stream.
questions.zh: 把鞋子拿在手上，我們涉水過河。
questions.explain: 原句 = We carried our shoes in our hands and crossed the stream.

questions.q: ____ my homework, I went home.
questions.zh: 功課做完後，我就回家了。
questions.explain:
① Having + p.p. 之分詞完成式，表示動作時間比主句之動作要早。
② 原句 = After I had finished my homework, I went home.

questions.q: ____ the door unlocked, I went in.
questions.zh: 發現門沒鎖，我就進去了。
questions.explain:
原句 = As I found the door unlocked, I went in.
✕ ✕ Finding the door unlocked, I went in.

questions.q: ____ a careless fellow, he forgot all about it.
questions.zh: 他是個粗心的傢伙，整件事都忘了。
questions.explain: 原句 = As he was a careless fellow, ...

questions.q: ____ carefully, this letter is very beautiful.
questions.zh: 因為字打得很仔細，這封信十分好看。
questions.explain:
原句 = As it is typed carefully, this letter is...
✕ ✕ ✕ Typed carefully, this letter is...

questions.q: Animals can do many amazing things when properly ____.
questions.zh: 當動物加以適當訓練時，能做出許多驚人的事。
questions.explain: 原句 = ... when they are properly trained.

questions.q: You must be careful when ____ on the highway.
questions.zh: 開車時，你要小心。
questions.explain: 原句 = you must be careful when (you are) driving.

questions.q: If ____, I will go to the party tonight.
questions.zh: 如果被邀請，晚上我便會去參加宴會。
questions.explain: If invited... = If I am invited...

questions.q: Thousands of products ____ from coal are now in daily use.
questions.zh: 數以千計由煤做成的東西，現在每天被使用。
questions.explain: products made from coal = products which were made... 把 which were 省略，保留過去分詞 made，以 made from coal 修飾 products。

questions.q: Engines are machines ____ power or motion.
questions.zh: 引擎是能產生力量或動力的機器。
questions.explain: machines producing... = machines which produce...

questions.q: During this battle some soldiers were wounded, and some ____.
questions.zh: 在這場戰役中，有些士兵受傷，有些士兵則失蹤了。
questions.explain: missing 表示「行蹤不明」。

questions.q: Weather ____, we will have a picnic tomorrow.
questions.zh: 天氣好的話，我們明天要去野餐。
questions.explain: Weather permitting = If the weather permits

questions.q: The vacation ____ over, the students came back to school.
questions.zh: 假期結束，學生們回到學校。
questions.explain:
① 分詞構句意義上的主詞與主句主詞不同時，就要保留。
② 原句 = As the vacation was over, the students...

questions.q: ____, we left off our work.
questions.zh: 太陽下山後，我們停工了。
questions.explain:
① Having + p.p. 之分詞現在完成式，表示動作時間比主句之動作要早。
② 分詞構句的意義上的主詞與主句的主詞不同時，保留分詞短語前面的主詞。

questions.q: The hotel room was so dirty that I was ____ and complained to the manager.
questions.zh: 這旅館的房間太髒，使我感到厭惡，於是向經理抱怨。
questions.explain: 用過去分詞形容人的情緒，表示「某人感到～」。

questions.q: The speaker found himself ____ all alone.
questions.zh: 那位說話者發現自己是孤零零的一個。
questions.explain: find oneself + 過去分詞，表示「發現自己陷於某種情況」。

questions.q: In the airport I met a man ____ my cousin.
questions.zh: 在機場我遇到一個和我堂兄長得很像的人。
questions.explain:
原句 = ... I met a man who resembled my cousin.（形容詞子句）
= ... I met a man resembling my cousin.（分詞片語）

questions.q: Both history and geography are ____ courses in our middle schools.
questions.zh: 在我們中學歷史和地理是必修課程。
questions.explain:
required courses（必修課程）
selective courses（選修課程）

questions.q: In many modern cities, Beijing ____, congestion and air pollution have become real problems.
questions.zh: 在許多現代化城市中，包括北京，擁擠與空氣污染已變成很實際的問題了。
questions.explain: 「包括」：including + N. = N. + included = inclusive of + N.

questions.q: He devoted his ____ five years to study and ____.
questions.zh: 他將剩下的五年全心投入在研究學問上。
questions.explain:
① devote to + V-ing / N（專心於）
② his remaining years = his last years（他的晚年／餘年）
③ study 當名詞用，作「研究」解。

questions.q: ____ with the price of a fixed home today, mobile homes are truly ____.
questions.zh: 在今天，和固定房屋的價格相比較，拖車型活動房屋真的很經濟。
questions.explain:
① be compared with（與～相比）
② economic（經濟學的）；economical（節省的、經濟實惠的）

questions.q: ____ the painting, he gave a sigh of relief.
questions.zh: 畫完圖畫之後，他鬆了一口氣。
questions.explain: 原句 = After he had finished...

questions.q: ____ by the roaring thunder, the baby burst out crying.
questions.zh: 嬰兒給隆隆的雷聲嚇壞了，哇的一聲哭了起來。
questions.explain:
原句 = As the baby was frightened by..., the baby...
= Being frightened by..., the baby...
= Frightened by..., the baby...

questions.q: ____, he can quickly find out what is wrong with a television set and repair it.
questions.zh: 因為受過良好的訓練，他能很快地發現電視的毛病並把它修好。
questions.explain: 原句 = As he has been well trained, ...

questions.q: ____ by hunger, he stole a cake.
questions.zh: 因為飢餓驅使，他偷了一塊蛋糕。
questions.explain: 原句 = As he was driven by hunger, ...

questions.q: ____ the way to take, the traveller went on his journey.
questions.zh: 在別人告訴他走那一條路後，旅遊者繼續他的行程。
questions.explain:
原句 = After he had been told..., the traveller went...
= Having been told..., the traveller went...
= Told..., the traveller went...

questions.q: The United States has developed into a modern nation in a very short time ____ with many other countries.
questions.zh: 跟其他許多國家比較，美國在一個很短時間內就發展成一個現代化國家。
questions.explain:
原句 = ... if it is compared with...
= ... compared with...

questions.q: ____, reports are prepared for busy administrators.
questions.zh: 一般而言，報告是為忙碌的行政主管人員準備的。
questions.explain: generally speaking（一般而言），為一獨立的分詞短語。

questions.q: The lesson ____ by the teacher this morning is an unusually long one.
questions.zh: 老師今早所指定的一課相當地長。
questions.explain: 原句 = The lesson which was assigned by the teacher...

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依據中文提示，填入最適當的字詞

questions.q: A ____ dog is often ____ ____ than a ____ lion.
questions.zh: 吠犬往往比睡獅有用。
questions.explain: barking 與 sleeping 均為現在分詞，修飾名詞 dog 及 lion。

questions.q: ____ ____ the right, you will find the post office.
questions.zh: 向右轉，你就會找到郵局。
questions.explain:
Turning to the right, you will find...
= If you turn to the right, you will find...
= Turn to the right, and you will find...

questions.q: ____ others may say, you should act ____ ____ the plan.
questions.zh: 不論別人怎麼說，你都該按照計劃行事。
questions.explain:
① However + 形/副 + S + V, S + V（不論多麼；無論如何…）
② Whatever + S + V, S + V（不論什麼）

questions.q: He ____ still on the grass, ____ his eyes ____.
questions.zh: 他靜靜地躺在草地上，眼睛閉著。
questions.explain:
① lie-lay-lain-lying（躺；位於）
② 本句亦可寫成 He lay still on the grass, and his eyes closed。

questions.q: ____ ____ his accent, he ____ ____ England.
questions.zh: 從口音判斷，他來自英國。
questions.explain: Judging from + N（由…判斷）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 依據中文及提示翻譯成英文

questions.q: 大致上說，住鄉下比住都市好多了。
answer: Generally speaking, living in the country is much better than living in the city.
In general, living in the country is much better than living in the city.
questions.zh: 大致上說，住鄉下比住都市好多了。
questions.explain:
加強比較級，可用 much/far/still/even 等副詞。
[例] Life today is much (far/still/even) more convenient than it was fifty years ago.（現在的生活比起五十年前要方便多了。）

questions.q: 就以空氣而論，鄉下的新鮮而都市的污濁。
questions.hint: 就以…而論：As far as... be concerned
answer: As far as air is concerned, country air is fresh while city air is dirty.
As far as air is concerned, country air is fresh while city air is polluted.
questions.zh: 就以空氣而論，鄉下的新鮮而都市的污濁。
questions.explain:
S + V... while + S + V（…而…）
[例] Some habits are good while others are bad.（有些習慣是好的而有些則是壞的。）

questions.q: 若談起生活，鄉下悠閒而都市匆忙。
answer: When it comes to life, country life is leisurely while city life is hasty.
Speaking of life, country life is leisurely while city life is hasty.
Talking of life, country life is leisurely while city life is hasty.
questions.zh: 若談起生活，鄉下悠閒而都市匆忙。
questions.explain:
「一提到」：When it comes to + N/V-ing, S + V
[例] When it comes to cooking, I am all thumbs.（提到烹飪，我是笨手笨腳的。）

questions.q: 而且，鄉下人純樸，老實，待人親切。
questions.answer: In addition, country people are simple, honest and friendly with others.
questions.zh: 而且，鄉下人純樸，老實，待人親切。
questions.explain:
「而且／此外／再者」可用：
Besides, S + V
In addition, S + V
Moreover, S + V

questions.q: 常到鄉下度週末是多麼棒的事呀！
questions.answer: How wonderful it is to spend the weekends in the country as often as not.
questions.zh: 常到鄉下度週末是多麼棒的事呀！
questions.explain:
① 本句 it 為形式主詞，to spend... country 為真正主詞。
② as often as not = often（時常；常常）

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文並選出最適當的答案：

While (1) to the movies, I happened to see a terrible accident. A taxi (2) through a traffic light collided with a truck. The (3) taxi driver was sent to hospital (4) at downtown area immediately. As the number of cars (5), everyone has to strictly obey the traffic rules.

【詞彙及短語提示】
1. 人 + happen to + V：某人碰巧…
2. terrible accident：可怕的車禍
3. run through a red light：闖紅燈
4. collide with：與…相撞
5. immediately = right away：立刻；馬上
6. strictly（副）嚴格地
7. obey the traffic rules：遵守交通規則

questions.q: While ____ to the movies, I happened to see a terrible accident.
questions.zh: 去電影院時，我碰巧看到了一場可怕的車禍。
questions.explain:
While I went to..., I happened to...
= While going to..., I happened to...

questions.q: A taxi ____ through a traffic light collided with a truck.
questions.zh: 一輛闖紅燈的計程車與一輛卡車相撞。
questions.explain:
原句 = A taxi [which ran through]... collided with...
（形容詞子句簡化為分詞片語）
= A taxi [running through]... collided with...

questions.q: The ____ taxi driver was sent to hospital located at downtown area immediately.
questions.zh: 受傷的計程車司機立刻被送往位於市區的醫院。
questions.explain: injured（形）受傷的

questions.q: The injured taxi driver was sent to hospital ____ at downtown area immediately.
questions.zh: 受傷的計程車司機立刻被送往位於市區的醫院。
questions.explain:
... hospital which is located at...
= ... hospital located at...

questions.q: As the number of cars ____, everyone has to strictly obey the traffic rules.
questions.zh: 隨著汽車數量的增加，每個人都必須嚴格遵守交通規則。
questions.explain:
原句 = As the number... increases, everyone has to...
= With the increasing number of cars, everyone has to...
